name: Slow parallax story
summary: Full-bleed textural narrative: one eased depth move per scene reveals layered texture behind the subject, then the frame holds.

forbidden: continuous parallax drift or idle depth motion between moves (R3, R4)
bounce, elastic or back overshoot on any entrance (R1)
more than one depth move per scene (R3)

frame_checklist: The subject stays readable on the first and last frame of the scene
Captions sit inside the title-safe box at every depth position (R5)
The depth move starts and ends in a held frame (R3)
Texture stays quiet enough that no more than one sentence competes with it (R6)
No layer moves after the scene's hold begins (R4)
source_techniques: explainer-motion-craft: R3 one-move-then-hold structure (reference only, no code copied)
